issue.title: webapp: Cannot choose scan type for DVB-S2 cards
issue.body:
* **Platform**:
Linux dvr 5.15.0-122-generic #132-Ubuntu SMP Thu Aug 29 13:45:52 UTC 2024 x86_64 x86_64 x86_64 GNU/Linux

* **MythTV version**:
fixes/34

* **Package version**:

* **Component**:
Backend

### What steps will reproduce the bug?
Open webapp on port 6544 and navigate to 'Input connections'.
Click on  "Enable updates"
Open one of the DVB inputs.
Click on "Scan for channels"
Click on "Scan Type" combo-box

### How often does it reproduce? Is there a required condition?
Always

### What is the expected behaviour?
A list of different scan types

### What do you see instead?
Combo-box shows "Failed to open the card"

### Additional information
/var/log/mythtv/mythbackend.log shows the following:

```
Dec 31 17:32:07 dvr mythbackend: mythbackend[2615]: E HTTP2 cardutil.cpp:1249 (OpenVideoDevice) CardUtil: Can't open DVB frontend (/dev/dvb/adapter0/frontend0) for /dev/dvb/adapter0/frontend0.#012#011#011#011eno: Device or resource busy (16)
Dec 31 17:32:07 dvr mythbackend: mythbackend[2615]: E HTTP2 cardutil.cpp:928 (ProbeCurrentDeliverySystem) CardUtil: open failed (/dev/dvb/adapter0/frontend0)#012#011#011#011eno: Device or resource busy (16)
```

I tried disabling the background EIT scan but that didn't help.

I also tried a small test program with the code from cardutil.cpp:
```
#include <stdio.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <sys/ioctl.h>

int main(int argc, char** argv)
{
   int fd = open(argv[1], O_RDONLY | O_NONBLOCK);
   printf("%s: fd = %d\n", argv[1], fd);
   return 0;
}
```

That always seems to return a valid file handle:
```
$ ./dvb /dev/dvb/adapter0/frontend0
/dev/dvb/adapter0/frontend0: fd = 3
$ ./dvb /dev/dvb/adapter1/frontend0
/dev/dvb/adapter1/frontend0: fd = 3
````

comment.body:
OK, I managed to mess up copying one line into the test program!  :roll_eyes: 
cardutil opens the device with `O_RDWR` and not `O_RDONLY` (as I had).

Opening the device with `O_RDWR` causes the test program to fail too.

So the issue seems to be that the devices are not being closed when clicking on 'Enable updates'.

Bumps [prettier](https://github.com/prettier/prettier) from 3.4.1 to 3.4.2.
Release notes

3.4.2

🔗 Changelog

Changelog

Sourced from prettier's changelog.

3.4.2

diff

Treat U+30A0 & U+30FB in Katakana Block as CJK (#16796 by @​tats-u)

Prettier doesn't treat U+30A0 & U+30FB as Japanese. U+30FB is commonly used in Japanese to represent the delimitation of first and last names of non-Japanese people or “and”. The following “C言語・C++・Go・Rust” means “C language & C++ & Go & Rust” in Japanese.

<!-- Input (--prose-wrap=never) -->

C言

語

・

C++

・

Go

・

Rust


<!-- Prettier 3.4.1 -->

C言語・ C++ ・ Go ・ Rust


<!-- Prettier 3.4.2 -->

C言語・C++・Go・Rust

U+30A0 can be used as the replacement of the - in non-Japanese names (e.g. “Saint-Saëns” (Charles Camille Saint-Saëns) can be represented as “サン゠サーンス” in Japanese), but substituted by ASCII hyphen (U+002D) or U+FF1D (full width hyphen) in many cases (e.g. “サン=サーンス” or “サン＝サーンス”).

Fix comments print on class methods with decorators (#16891 by @​fisker)

// Input
class A {
  @decorator
  /** 
   * The method description
   *
  */
  async method(foo: Foo, bar: Bar) {
    console.log(foo);
  }
}

// Prettier 3.4.1

class A {

@​decorator

async /**

</tr></table>

issue.body:
Updates the requirements on [phpstan/phpstan](https://github.com/phpstan/phpstan) to permit the latest version.
Release notes

Sourced from phpstan/phpstan's releases.

2.0.3

This release includes improvements and fixes from PHPStan 1.12.12.

Bleeding edge 🔪

  • Check that values passed to array_sum/product are castable to number (level 5) (#3658), #11883, thanks @​schlndh!

If you want to see the shape of things to come and adopt bleeding edge features early, you can include this config file in your project's phpstan.neon:

includes:
	- vendor/phpstan/phpstan/conf/bleedingEdge.neon

Of course, there are no backwards compatibility guarantees when you include this file. The behaviour and reported errors can change in minor versions with this file included. Learn more

Improvements 🔧

  • Update BetterReflection with Roave/BetterReflection#1462, thanks @​kukulich!
  • Sanity checks around hooked properties in interfaces and classes (#3656), thanks @​jakubtobiasz!
    • Full support for PHP 8.4 is coming soon in PHPStan 2.1

Bugfixes 🐛

  • Fix subtracting enums inside in_array (#3646), #12083, thanks @​janedbal!
  • Last value was not recognized when passing an associative array as an argument (#3668), #11815, thanks @​sayuprc!
  • Update PhpStorm stubs (#3683), #12132

Function signature fixes 🤖

  • 3rd parameter of htmlentities and htmlspecialchars allows null (#3644), thanks @​sreichel!
  • Update curl_setopt string values and allow nullable (#3634), thanks @​xPaw!* bccomp: more precise return type (#3647), thanks @​claudepache!

Internals 🔍

  • FunctionCallParametersCheck: Add native parameter type (#3641), thanks @​staabm!
  • Refactor TryRemove/Accepts for DateTime|DateTimeImmutable and Exception|Error (#3654), thanks @​VincentLanglet!
  • Implement Scope::getPhpVersion() (#3642), thanks @​staabm!
  • Non-capturing catch support detection is scope PHP-version dependent (#3663), #12114, thanks @​staabm!
  • Remove shortArraySyntax definition in Printer::__construct() (#3680), thanks @​samsonasik!
